description.text: Tuition FeeRMB 12,000 per yearRMB 48,000 in total (About $ 6,705)

duration.text: The Chinese Language and Literature at Wuchang University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.*1. White background colored bareheaded digital photo in Passport sizeThe head takes up 2/3 of the size of the photo; the photo pixel is no less than 320*240, the aspect ratio is 4:3, the size is 100-500kb, JPG format.*2. Colored scanned copy of passport which is valid for at least one yearThe whole page of first page in your passport.*3. None criminal record*4. The colored scanned copy of the original diploma of secondary high school and aboveIf it is not in English, an English or Chinese translation shall be provided.*5. The colored scanned copy of the original transcript of secondary high school and aboveIf it is not in English, an English or Chinese translation shall be provided.*6. Fixed deposit certificate with minimum US $3000*7. Medical report*8. Educational background and working experience detailed from primary school to the date of application9. Transfer letter with attendance record for applicants with studying experience in China

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens of secondary high school graduates, holding valid foreign passports, 17 ~ 25 years old, in good health, and with good character.
